hana: Observed a weird one on the canary: osprey-v1-int4 returned a tool_call where the tool args field is a JSON string (double-encoded) instead of an object. runtime tries to JSON.parse and fails because it expects an object. example below. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

hana: prompt: "Call stock_lookup for AAPL"
hana: model raw response captured:
```json
{"type":"tool_call","tools":[{"name":"stock_lookup","args":"{\"symbol\":\"AAPL\",\"range\":\"1d\"}"}]}
```

eli: interesting. i can repro hitting the canary endpoint. frequency ~5/200. seems more common when the tool name is short and there's trailing punctuation in the user prompt.

priya: telemetry: metric `toolcall.args_stringified.count` jumped to 42 in 10m for osprey-v1-int4. attached sample token dumps to s3://canaries/osprey-v1-int4/dumps/.

runtime-bot: logs show alternating correct and double-encoded responses:
[2026-03-23T17:11:05Z] INFO resp: {"type":"tool_call","tools":[{"name":"stock_lookup","args":{"symbol":"AAPL","range":"1d"}}]}
[2026-03-23T17:11:06Z] INFO resp: {"type":"tool_call","tools":[{"name":"stock_lookup","args":"{\"symbol\":\"AAPL\",\"range\":\"1d\"}"}]}

eli: hypothesis: int4 quantized decoder occasionally emits verbatim quote characters and braces as tokens instead of structured tokens, causing model to wrap the args as a string. Could be tokenizer detokenization quirk with micro-batching/prefix caching.

priya: quick mitigations discussed:
- parser tolerant mode: if args is a string, attempt a safe JSON.parse and validate shape; if parse fails, treat as malformed and soft-rescue (ask model to reemit).
- router fallback: if we observe args_stringified rate > threshold for a model, fallback to osprey-v1-fp16 for that request.
- schema rule: validator should accept args as object only; emit telemetry and trigger soft-rescue when args is not object.

hana: i implemented a safe-parser in the runtime that tries parse-if-string but also checks for suspicious patterns (e.g., leading/trailing quotes, balanced braces). it logs both the raw string and parsed structure to S3 with PII redaction. rolling to 10% canary now.

eli: local run of 1k calls with safe-parser: parsing success for ~78% of stringified args; remaining cases triggered a soft-rescue prompt: "Your previous tool_call had args serialized as a string. Please re-output the tool_call with args as an object." Reemit success about 65% of the time. net failure rate dropped by ~90%.

qa-bot: added onboarding smoke test vector that intentionally exercises quoted args and short tool names under int4 quant path. failing cases upload both tokenids and raw token text to s3 for debug.

priya: long-term: runtime+tokenizer teams to investigate detokenization mapping for quote/brace tokens in int4 kernels; add structured-output fuzzing to onboarding pipeline to catch double-encoding. create issue RW-ml/3710 and assign runtime+tokenizer. checklist: kernel bisect, tokenizer mapping audit, schema enforcement PR, onboarding smoke, telemetry alert.

hana: opened RW-ml/3710 and added the experiment artifacts. thanks all. :raised_hands:
